key_highlights: ASX falls to fresh six-week low as Middle East/Hormuz Strait escalation drives oil toward US$100, fuelling rate hike bets
RBA 'chooses recession' – hawkish stance intensifies as business conditions hit weakest since pandemic
Iron ore in sustained downtrend ('drowning, not waving') pressuring BHP, RIO, FMG
Home buyer sentiment collapses to new milestone; NZ house price crash echoes across region
Big four banks (CBA, ANZ, NAB, WBC) fall on rising rate expectations and credit risk
Santos gas cartel dynamics shift; energy transition disrupted by data centre demand
Gold strength (Forrestania 2Moz milestone, Kaiser Tassie expansion) signals safe-haven rotation
China-US tensions escalate, threatening commodity demand outlook

sectors.trend: Severely negative. Iron ore in structural downtrend; China patience with Trump wanes, threatening demand. Gold counters with safe-haven bid (Forrestania 2Moz, Kaiser Tassie).
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin pressure from weak iron ore. Gold miners (GOLD.AX, NVA.AX, STO.AX) benefit from geopolitical premium. Diversify away from iron ore exposure.

sectors.trend: Negative. Big four banks fall as rising oil fuels rate hike bets, compressing net interest margins and raising credit risk. RBA 'chooses recession' path.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, ANZ.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX under pressure. NIM compression vs. rising NPLs in a recessionary scenario. Defensive yield still attractive but capital at risk.

sectors.trend: Mixed-to-positive for oil, negative for gas. Hormuz Strait escalation pushes oil to US$100. Santos gas cartel dynamics shift. Data centres disrupt energy transition.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX benefit from oil spike. STO.AX faces gas price pressure. Energy transition stocks (SOL.AX, LRN.AX) face headwinds from data centre demand.

sectors.trend: Negative. Business conditions weakest since pandemic. Home buyer sentiment collapses. 102-year-old mall retailer closes 25 stores. Living standards in decline.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WBC.AX (retail), IAG.AX face demand softness. Insurance premiums rising (car supply crunch). Consumer staples defensive but margin pressure.

sectors.trend: Relatively resilient. Gold as safe haven. Healthcare (CSL.AX) benefits from defensive rotation. ED data shows system strain.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX offer relative safety. Gold ETFs (GOLD.AX, GDX) attract flows. REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) pressured by rate environment.

sectors.trend: Structurally challenged. 'Australia has lost the ability to build things.' 6,000 tradies to get free qualifications under Labor scheme.
sectors.implications: WTC.AX, INC.AX, GPT.AX face capacity constraints but policy support. Long-term structural opportunity if labour pipeline addressed.

key_themes: Geopolitical risk premium: Hormuz Strait escalation, oil at US$100, Middle East flare-up
RBA hawkish pivot: 'chooses recession' – rate hike bets intensify
Iron ore structural weakness: China demand concerns, multiple bearish signals
Domestic demand collapse: business conditions weakest since pandemic, home buyer sentiment at milestone low
Gold safe-haven bid: Forrestania 2Moz, Kaiser Tassie, price signals Trump uncertainty
China-US decoupling accelerates: 'run out of patience with Trump'
Energy transition disruption: data centres vs. renewables, gas cartel shift
Living standards decline masked by public sector employment

risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge with energy exposure (WDS.AX), gold (GOLD.AX), and cash. Reduce net long equity beta.
Reduce rate-sensitive REIT and property exposure. Favour fixed-income and dividend payers with pricing power.
Underweight BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX. Rotate to gold and diversified miners.
Reduce consumer discretionary exposure. Favour staples (WES.AX) and healthcare (CSL.AX).
Monitor AUD/USD. Reduce China-revenue exposure. Gold and domestic-focused names offer relative safety.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: S&P 500 short interest at decade highs / global risk-off
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce global equity beta. Use inverse ETFs selectively. Maintain cash buffer.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold miners and gold ETFs
opportunities.rationale: Geopolitical premium, RBA hawkishness, and China-US tensions drive safe-haven demand. Forrestania 2Moz and Kaiser Tassie confirm sector momentum.

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical long on oil & gas producers
opportunities.rationale: Hormuz Strait escalation and oil at US$100 create immediate upside for Australian energy names.
Recession risk and demand collapse favour defensive rotation. CSL.AX retains global pricing power.

defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore in structural downtrend; China demand risk. BHP, RIO, FMG face margin compression.
RBA 'chooses recession' path; rising rates compress valuations. Home buyer sentiment at milestone low.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce net long equity beta; increase cash/short-duration bonds
defensive_moves.rationale: ASX at six-week low, S&P short interest at decade highs, multiple concurrent risk factors. Preserve capital.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight big four banks on credit risk
defensive_moves.rationale: Recession + rising rates = NPL pressure. NIM compression. Rate hike bets already pricing in stress.

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. ASX likely to test lower support as oil-driven inflation fears keep RBA hawkish. Six-week low may extend. Volatility elevated on Hormuz/Middle East headlines. Gold and energy outperform; banks, materials, REITs lag. AUD/USD under pressure from risk-off flows.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive if geopolitical de-escalation occurs. Structural themes: gold supply growth (Forrestania, Kaiser), infrastructure build-out (6,000 tradies scheme), energy transition disruption. However, iron ore structural weakness and China decoupling cap materials upside. RBA recession path may force eventual rate cuts, supporting equities in H2 2026.
key_catalysts: RBA next meeting and rate decision
Hormuz Strait / Middle East conflict resolution or escalation
Iron ore price trajectory and China stimulus signals
US CPI / NFP data impacting global rate expectations
Santos gas pricing and cartel dynamics
AUD/USD reaction to commodity and rate differentials
Q3 earnings season (banks, miners) starting late September
watch_list: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX – iron ore price sensitivity
CBA.AX, ANZ.AX – NIM and credit guidance
RBA cash rate and forward guidance
